{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check for sentinel values
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:", df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Identify rows with sentinel values
sentinel_mask = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) | (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)
print(f"Number of rows with sentinel values: {sentinel_mask.sum()}")

# Check if sentinel values are concentrated in one arm
sentinel_by_arm = df[sentinel_mask].groupby('arm').size()
print(f"Sentinel value distribution by arm: {sentinel_by_arm.to_dict()}")

# Show the actual values for sentinel rows
sentinel_rows = df[sentinel_mask]
print("Sentinel rows (first 5):")
print(sentinel_rows[['patient_id', 'arm', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].head(5))"}
